2026_02_NO_BAL.headline: Baltimore’s ground power meets a Saints defense searching for answers
2026_02_NO_BAL.paragraph1: New Orleans faces another demanding rushing test after allowing Jahmyr Gibbs a huge opener, with Derrick Henry coming off a three-touchdown performance for Baltimore. Tyler Shough’s mobility gives the Saints a way to stress the Ravens beyond structure, but Baltimore’s defense can make the game difficult if it wins early downs and compresses the pocket. The Ravens are banged up at receiver, increasing the importance of Henry, Lamar Jackson’s legs and New Orleans’ ability to crowd the run without surrendering explosives.
2026_02_NO_BAL.model_rationale: New Orleans must survive Baltimore’s rushing efficiency without overcommitting bodies that expose explosive lanes, while Shough needs enough protection to punish pressure and extend drives.
